{{Top|leg|canon=Tech droid}}
A '''technical droid''' or '''tech droid''' was a [[Class two droid/Legends|class two droid]] type<ref name="SWS">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]'' establishes that technical droids are classified as [[Class two droid/Legends|class two droid]]s.</ref> used to maintain vehicles. [[B-3Z technical droid]]s were employed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] on [[Culroon III/Legends|Culroon III]].<ref name="Promotion">{{WEGCite|story=The Promotion of Lieutenant Veers|book=The Star Wars Sourcebook|reprint=1}}</ref>
